artifact: grace_window_v1: does the terrain do the reading?
status: FROZEN before any experiment code was written. Scored once, as frozen.
authorship: Claude, at Rusty McMurray's direction ('Let's focus here', 2026-10-18), under the decisions he delegated earlier that day. Successor to grace_window_v0 (PREREG ecbc3e4b..., receipt 0bf54547...).
why_v1: grace_window_v0 passed its primary prediction (P4: organization, not amount, set the landing; shuffle control P8). Its reader was miscalibrated: a plug-in baseline test gave per-place false support of 5.5-11.5% under NULL. That caused P5 to fail (24% of place-confound histories crossed). An 18-day bad stretch fooled it 63% of the time (P11, predicted).

Post-hoc (v0 diagnostics, same seeds): with a two-sample test, a plain place-tagged counter separates well (SPREAD 87%, CONCENTRATED 9.5%, NULL 0%). The stateless lattice keeps almost no power (SPREAD 3%).

Post-hoc on sdkp_r3 v1 (r3_thinning_probe/): sdkp_r3's lattice-over-counter advantage (separation 0.755 vs 0.495) is reproduced with no lattice by a THINNED counter. That counter emits a signal with p=0.23 for a truncated reply and 0.007 for an ordinary one, the lattice's calibrated rates. It gave 0.780, and 0.840 in an earlier probe version that consumed extra random draws.

Structural reason: Rusty's fold never reads self.state, so each tuple is a randomized function of (place, truncated). A lattice fed only by those labels cannot carry more about the history than the labels do (data-processing inequality). This holds for any lattice, state-dependent or not.
question: If the substrate has memory (a folded crease holds until it relaxes), does the terrain itself discount concentrated evidence? The test is whether a reader that sees only total counts, blind to place and time, can then tell a spread preference from a confound. And under calibrated readers, how do four sensors compare: counter, thinned counter, Rusty's lattice as is, and the lattice with fold memory?
what_this_cannot_show: No sensor fed only by (place, truncated) can beat the labels in information. A FOLD_MEMORY pass shows the substrate can compute an organization feature for a naive reader. It does not show a lattice is needed: a per-place saturating counter could compute the same feature (not tested here).

world.replies: 8 per day for 180 days (1440 replies). Each reply's place is drawn from occupancy with seed [20261019, s]. The same schedule is used for every condition of stream s.
world.periods: Baseline days 1-60 (480 replies). Signal period days 61-180 (960 replies), in four time blocks: B1 61-90, B2 91-120, B3 121-150, B4 151-180.
world.base_truncation: Every reply is truncated with probability 0.10, seed [20261019, s, 1], identical across conditions.
world.extras: E = 100. Per stream, k_s = min(E, number of base-ordinary signal-period replies at P1, number of base-ordinary replies on days 96-115). EVERY condition of stream s except NULL gets exactly k_s extras, so counts are matched exactly (fixes v0 E1). P(k_s < 100) is about 0.0017.
world.extras_seed: [20261019, s, 2, condition_index] for the source condition; the shuffle uses [20261019, s, 3, condition_index].
world.fold_seeds: As v0: before each fold, numpy's global RNG is seeded with int(sha256(organism_id|verbosity|reply_index|place|truncated)[:16], 16) mod 2^32; its prior state is restored afterwards.
world.sparks: ordinary 0.3, truncated 0.6, at the place's corner.
world.power_note: Analytic, pre-freeze, from the calibrated rates: under the calibrated per-place readers the lattice sensors have LOW power in this world. Expected LATTICE SPREAD crossing under R_PLACE is about 0.2, with per-place power 0.15-0.27. COUNTER is about 0.94. So Part A's lattice comparisons concern calibration and equivalence, not lattice usefulness. Part B, the pooled naive reader with ample power, carries the SDKP question.

conditions.SPREAD: k_s extras drawn uniformly from all base-ordinary signal-period replies: a genuine preference.
conditions.CONCENTRATED: k_s extras drawn uniformly from base-ordinary signal-period replies at P1: a place confound (the commute).
conditions.BURST: k_s extras drawn uniformly from base-ordinary replies on days 96-115 (inside B2), all places: a temporal confound (a bad stretch).
conditions.SHUFFLED_BURST: BURST's truncation flags permuted across all signal-period replies. This keeps per-place reply counts and the total count, and breaks the tie between signal and time.

sensors.COUNTER: signal = the reply is truncated; position = its place.
sensors.THINNED: signal with probability 0.23 if truncated and 0.007 if ordinary (the lattice's calibrated rates); position = its place. Each draw is seeded by sha256(organism_id|thin|reply_index|place|truncated). Stateless; no lattice.
sensors.LATTICE: Rusty's OrigamiLattice, unchanged. One lattice per stream and condition, folds in order. A signal tuple is Size >= 1; its position is the tuple's Position quadrant.
sensors.FOLD_MEMORY: fold_memory.FoldMemoryLattice: Rusty's fold with one added rule, that a folded cell holds and only unfolded cells can fold. Before each day's first reply (days 2-180), each folded cell unfolds with probability LAMBDA = 1.0, seeded by sha256(organism_id|verbosity|relax|day). Signal tuple and position as LATTICE.

calibration_pre_freeze.what: calibration/calibrate_fold_memory.py, run before this file was written: sensor only, background world, seeds [777, s], no test condition. Its criterion was declared in its docstring before it ran.
calibration_pre_freeze.criterion: LAMBDA = the smallest grid value (longest memory) that keeps the busiest corner's truncated-spark yield >= 0.115 (half the fresh yield) under background load.
calibration_pre_freeze.result: Only LAMBDA = 1.0 qualifies (P0 yield 0.143; at 0.7 it is 0.098; at 0.5, 0.070). Background traffic saturates any slower-relaxing lattice, so FOLD_MEMORY's memory spans about one day.
calibration_pre_freeze.dose_response_at_LAMBDA_1: Marginal signal yield per extra truncated spark falls with that corner's extras per day: corner0 0.150 at 0.24/day to 0.098 at 2.5/day; corner1 0.152 at 0.11/day to 0.140 at 1.07/day. The stateless lattice stays about 0.21-0.24 at every load.
calibration_pre_freeze.implication_written_before_any_test_run: FOLD_MEMORY should discount temporal concentration (BURST packs about 6 extras a day into 20 days), by roughly 20% relative to SPREAD. It should barely discount place concentration (CONCENTRATED adds about 1 a day at P1): roughly 4%.

readers.R_NAIVE: Place-blind and time-blind. k0 and n0 are signal tuples and replies on days 1-60 (all positions); k1 and n1 are the same for days 61-180. Terrain excess: Delta = k1 - n1*k0/n0. Decision: one-sided Fisher exact test (alternative 'greater') on [[k1, n1-k1], [k0, n0-k0]]; CROSS if p < 0.05 with magnitude 0.25, otherwise HOLD.
readers.R_PLACE: Time-blind, calibrated. For each place p: k0_p and n0_p are signal tuples with position p and replies at p, days 1-60; k1_p and n1_p are the same for days 61-180. A place is eligible if n1_p >= 20; it supports if a one-sided Fisher exact test on [[k1_p, n1_p-k1_p], [k0_p, n0_p-k0_p]] gives p < 0.05. g_place = supporting / eligible. CROSS if g_place >= 0.5, with magnitude 0.25*g_place.
readers.R_FULL: Places x time, calibrated. g_place as in R_PLACE. Block b supports if a one-sided Fisher test of its signal tuples and replies (all places) against the baseline (k0, n0) gives p < 0.05. g_time = supporting blocks / 4. CROSS if g_place >= 0.5 and g_time >= 0.5, with magnitude 0.25*min(g_place, g_time).
readers.landing: Applied on day 180 after verifying the grant signature and expiry. HOLD: stays at 0.5. CROSS: landing = clamp(0.5 - magnitude, [0, 1]).

grant: As v0, signed at the end of the baseline: {organism_id, category 'verbosity', direction -1, window 0.25, prior_value 0.5, category_sequence 0, constitution_root, issued_day 60, expires_day 200}. Deterministic Ed25519 key per stream (seed text 'grace_window_v1-owner-<s>'). No magnitude, no terrain root (ruling O1 carried).
rulings_carried_from_v0: O1 UNBOUND; O2 refinement of D1 (the terrain may hold or set magnitude inside the window); O3 HOLD on insufficient support; O5 landing magnitude.

definitions.cross(sensor, reader, condition): the share of 200 streams that CROSS.
definitions.rel_B(sensor): under R_NAIVE: [mean Delta(SPREAD) - mean Delta(BURST)] / mean Delta(SPREAD), over streams.
definitions.paired CI: a paired bootstrap over streams of the mean per-stream difference: 10,000 resamples, seed [20261019, 5]. 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles.

C1_count_matching.claim: Every non-NULL condition of every stream has exactly k_s extras, and every non-NULL condition has the same total truncation count (100% of streams).

C2_counter_naive_identical.claim: COUNTER under R_NAIVE gives identical Delta and decision across SPREAD, CONCENTRATED, BURST and SHUFFLED_BURST (100% of streams). This is v0's P10, now count-matched.

C3_replay_and_grant.claim: For LATTICE and FOLD_MEMORY, the owner's independent re-fold (including relaxation) reproduces every tuple and every reader's outcome in 100% of stream-conditions. Altering one recorded tuple is detected in 100% of trials (one per stream, SPREAD, FOLD_MEMORY). Grant bytes are identical across conditions and verify.

C4_bounds.claim: 100% of crossings, for every sensor and reader, move by at most 0.25, in the signed direction, within [0, 1].

A1_calibrated_null.claim: Under NULL, R_PLACE and R_FULL hold in >= 0.95 of streams for every sensor.

A2_time_breadth.claim: COUNTER under R_FULL: SPREAD crosses >= 0.80; CONCENTRATED holds >= 0.85; BURST holds >= 0.85.

A3_lattice_is_thinning.kind: mechanism claim (from v0 and sdkp_r3 post-hoc)
A3_lattice_is_thinning.claim: Under R_PLACE and under R_FULL, |cross(LATTICE) - cross(THINNED)| <= 0.10 in each of SPREAD, CONCENTRATED, BURST and NULL (8 comparisons). 0.10 is about 2 SE of a difference of two independent rates near 0.5 over 200 streams.

B1_terrain_discounts_bursts.claim: FOLD_MEMORY: rel_B >= 0.10, and the paired 95% CI of the per-stream difference Delta(SPREAD) - Delta(BURST) has a lower bound > 0.

B3_memory_limit_commute.claim: FOLD_MEMORY: rel_C < 0.10. One-day memory does not discount a place confound that arrives about once a day.

B4_shuffle.claim: FOLD_MEMORY: the paired 95% CI of Delta(SHUFFLED_BURST) - Delta(BURST) has a lower bound > 0, and |mean Delta(SHUFFLED_BURST) - mean Delta(SPREAD)| / mean Delta(SPREAD) <= 0.06.

exploratory_reported_not_scored.landing_consequence: Under R_PLACE (time-blind), D = [cross(SPREAD) - cross(BURST)]_FOLD_MEMORY - [cross(SPREAD) - cross(BURST)]_LATTICE. Direction expected positive (about +0.02); not scored because it is underpowered by design.
exploratory_reported_not_scored.tables: cross rate, mean magnitude, mean g and per-place support for every sensor x reader x condition; Delta per sensor x condition.
exploratory_reported_not_scored.position_leakage: the share of LATTICE and FOLD_MEMORY signal tuples whose Position differs from the reply's place.

limits_declared_now: One memory mechanism (crease holds, daily relaxation) with LAMBDA fixed by a declared calibration criterion. A different substrate property is a different hypothesis.
No sensor here can beat the labels in information. FOLD_MEMORY results concern computation, not information.
Synthetic owners, one world, authored conditions. Readers' thresholds (alpha 0.05, g >= 0.5, eligibility 20, 4 blocks) are builder choices.
Replay proves a landing follows from the recorded encounters, not that they happened.
rules: Scored once, as frozen. Deviations recorded, never re-scored. Construction checks are never counted as evidence.
run_v1.py refuses to run if this file, received/origami_kenta_sdkp.py or fold_memory.py differs from its frozen hash.
self_prediction: Every 'expected' value is the author's point prediction, made before any test-condition run, from the pre-freeze sensor calibration and v0's post-hoc diagnostics. The run reports the error on each numeric one.
